LEVELS OF ASSISTANCE AND AUTONOMY Five power levels to manage assistance in the best way, guaranteeing exceptional performance to tackle any type of route. MOTOR EDGE 2.0 is designed for demanding riders who want to get the most out of their e-bike. It offers the perfect balance of sporty performance and reliability, making it a trusted companion even on the most challenging trails. Developed with meticulous attention to detail, EDGE delivers up to 90 Nm of torque, ensuring greater power and easier maintenance. It also provides excellent torque assistance from low to high revs, ensuring a smooth ride even on the most challenging trails. BATTERY Infinity is the 900 Wh battery that ensures unprecedented range. Thanks to the latest-generation 21700 cells, greater capacity can be achieved without increasing overall space. This allows for the size and weight of a standard battery that integrates seamlessly into the frame, but with greater available energy. Infinity allows for a range of up to 250 km, ensuring long-lasting performance and fun.

BE GREEN TECHNOLOGIES Power, control, and design come together in the new TRAXE, the e-bike that transforms every ride into a unique experience. Created for the most demanding riders, it combines high-quality mechanics with advanced electric technology, giving you the freedom to choose your own route, always at peak performance. The E-FULL 29”/27.5” aluminum frame with integrated battery and carbon-look finish combines lightness and strength in a bold profile. 150 mm of travel and a thru-axle ensure stability and absolute control on the most challenging terrain. The Rock Shox 35 GOLD Air RL fork and Rock Shox Deluxe ULT Tru LO shock absorber work in perfect harmony to offer a smooth and precise ride. IDEAL FOR TRAXE is ideal for all-mountain use, for longer rides that require a longer battery life. From hilly trails to more technical routes, it allows you to tackle climbs and descents with high steering precision and maximum responsiveness. PERFECT FOR YOU IF If you're a biker looking for something new and want to tackle new trails, without worrying about the route or battery life. With TRAXE, you can get the most out of your mountain biking experience, thanks to its long-lasting battery, top-notch performance, and advanced, intelligent electric support.
